title: Human Development and Family Studies, B.S. — Human Development and Family Science Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: 2026-09-17 historical-year build for the 2025-2026 catalog edition. Fetched the real archived page (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/colleges/health-human-development/human-development-family-studies-bs/, raw curl + BeautifulSoup text extraction, not WebFetch's summarizer) and diffed it line-by-line against the 2026-2027 live page this plan's sibling file already models. Finding: the 2025-2026 edition's 'Human Development and Family Science Option' is IDENTICAL to 2026-2027's -- same Plan Code HDFS_BS, same Program Requirements course-by-course list (prescribed HDFS 216/301/311/312W; Additional Courses pools for Intro [HDFS 129/129S/101N], Foundations of Lifespan Development [HDFS 229/239/249N, select 6cr], Family Foundations [HDFS 315/315Y/SOC 30], Statistics [EDPSY 101/HDFS 200/STAT 200]; the same 18-credit option structure -- Advanced Development 3cr from the same 9-course list, Advanced Family Topics 3cr from the same 9-course list [including the HDFS 416/SOC 411 cross-listing], Professional Skills for HDFS Careers 6cr from the same 7-course list, Diversity and Development 6cr), the same Career Development and Experiential Learning Capstone pathway options (Traditional/Modified/Experiential Mix/Research Emphasis, all built around HDFS 490 as the common Fall precursor), and the same General Education breakdown (GQ 6, GWS 9, GA/GHW/GH/GS/GN 3 each, Inter-Domain 6, Exploration 9, totaling the same 45-credit Gen Ed figure). Total Credits table on the Suggested Academic Plan reads '120-123' for both editions. No course renumbering, no added/removed requirement, no credit-total change found -- copied this plan's semesters array verbatim from HDFS-2026.json (only catalog_year/source/notes differ), consistent with how CMPSC's own unchanged years are handled. Campus check: the 2025-2026 archived page's own 'Where can I complete this program?' section states this directly on the SAME page (no need for a separate University College mirror page, unlike what the 2026-2027 live page required) -- 'Degree Information At Additional Campuses: Altoona, Brandywine, DuBois, Fayette, Harrisburg, Mont Alto, Scranton, Shenango, York' and, further down, 'Human Development and Family Science Option -- Available at the following campuses: Altoona, Brandywine, DuBois, Fayette, Harrisburg, Mont Alto, Scranton, Shenango, University Park, World Campus, York' -- Brandywine confirmed Pattern A (same course list, verified identical above) for this catalog year too; Erie/Behrend is absent from every campus list on this page (both the top-level 'Additional Campuses' list and the option-specific list), consistent with every other catalog year checked this session (2022-2026) -- HDFS is not offered at Erie at all, so no campus edit for Erie, same as the 2026 file's own treatment.
